description: This file is a C header file (.h) that defines external API function prototypes for the Pipe Connector component within the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It includes function declarations for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing Pipe Connector objects, and contains licensing and author information.

methods.name: AnscCreatePipeConnector
methods.description: Function prototype for creating a Pipe Connector instance with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscPcoCreate
methods.description: Function prototype for creating a Pipe Connector object with specified container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscPcoRemove
methods.description: Function prototype for removing a Pipe Connector object.

methods.name: AnscPcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Function prototype for enrolling objects for the Pipe Connector.

methods.name: AnscPcoInitialize
methods.description: Function prototype for initializing the Pipe Connector object.
